provider: United States Geological Survey,3D Elevation Program

coverage_note: Every node of the previous263x197 scenery lattice is covered by valid classified ground. Adjacent one-metre tile40760 supplies the16m westernedge beyond tile116248; no extrapolation, water-plane fill, canopy/roof DSM or interpolation over missing ground.
method: Bilinear sampling of bounded4m F32 bare-earth export onto the retained12m scenery lattice. Default20m near-road join and horizon extent preserved. Racing widths/banking/protection unchanged.
